text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 70 syringes (6.6 days) of fondaparinux sodium 7.5 mg/0.6 mL. Corvale General holds 327.92 syringes (30.6 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 syringes (15.9 days). All three sites use NDC 11797015609 labeled by Italfarmaco S.p.A.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected ScinoPharm Taiwan, Ltd. (FEI 3002840477) on 2026-06-23 and classified the inspection OAI with seven observations including sterile procedures and validation deficiencies. Italfarmaco S.p.A. (FEI 1196) received a VAI classification on its most recent inspection ending 2023-06-28. The product is not on FDA’s drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside but critically low at Corvale East. No national shortage is declared. The OAI at ScinoPharm Taiwan is a quality signal for the shared NDC.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 79 syringes from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 3 syringes from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Evaluate purchase from Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Limited — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Eugia US LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Mylan Institutional LLC — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
